create_openpyxl_writer: create an OpenpyxlWriter instance to write pandas DataFrames to xlsx or xlsm Excel files
write_cells_with_styles: write cells to an Excel sheet with formatting including fonts, fills, borders, and alignments
save_workbook_to_disk: save an openpyxl workbook to disk, optionally truncating the file when appending to an existing workbook
read_excel_with_openpyxl_reader: read an Excel file using OpenpyxlReader with read_only and data_only mode for efficient parsing
convert_style_dict_to_openpyxl_objects: convert a style dictionary with font, fill, border, and alignment keys into native openpyxl style objects
